content: Human-labeling session — econ-silo-vs-spend:medium seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a tighter capital-allocation drill with heavier income. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), Ore Refinery (proc), Power Plant (powr) and TWO harvesters (harv, unarmed ore-collector trucks) on two ore patches, with $1800 cash. The 2000-ore storage cap saturates fast under heavy throughput. Within about 14 turns, reach economy value $2200, keep your Construction Yard and Refinery standing, and satisfy ONE of these: own an Ore Silo, kill at least two enemies, or own at least two pillboxes.
